key_insight: CalArena shows that post-hoc calibration works best when using smooth, calibration-aware methods, especially for multiclass and large-scale classification.
engineering_relevance: For deployed ML systems, the benchmark helps choose calibration methods that improve probability reliability without sacrificing predictive performance.
method: Standardized nearly 2000 post-hoc calibration experiments across tabular and computer vision tasks.
Compared binary, multiclass, and large-scale classifiers from classical models, deep networks, and foundation models.
Evaluated dozens of calibration methods in one reproducible framework using Post-Hoc Improvement (PHI).
evidence_signal: The benchmark aggregates predictions from diverse models across nearly 2000 experiments and uses PHI in proper scoring rules to assess both calibration quality and any degradation in predictive performance.
watch_item: Results are benchmark-dependent, so method rankings may shift with task mix, model family, or scoring rule choices.
paper_title: CalArena: A Large-Scale Post-Hoc Calibration Benchmark
